2.23.38
Tablix.Top
Applies to RDL 2008/01, RDL 2010/01, and RDL 2016/01
The Tablix.Top element specifies the distance of a Tablix from the top of the containing object. This
element is optional and MUST NOT be specified more than once. If this element is specified, it is of
type RdlSize. If this element is not specified, its value is interpreted as the minimum size.
Following is the parent element of the Tablix.Top element.
Parent elements
Tablix
The following is the XML Schema definition of the Tablix.Top element.
 <xsd:element name="Top" type="SizeType" minOccurs="0" />
